combined_saved_acoustic_and_additional_m.aggregation: Boolean OR of the unchanged acoustic warning and the added metric warning; missingness and unresolved source-AM risk remain separate. This is not a perceptual-quality or adoption classification.

original_relative_crossing_supplement.scope: Post hoc description of the saved RAW_FULL PML-relative crossing warning entries. No thresholds or flags are changed.
original_relative_crossing_supplement.comparison_note: The numerical tolerance above only handles binary floating-point representation of a saved 1 ms grid difference.

utmos.calibration: 対象ボコーダーでの人間評定校正は未実施

recognition.decoding: argmax logits then CTC collapse; no language model; batch_size=1

evaluator_source_provenance.scope: Frozen evaluator source and asset identities only; implementation code and model weights are not included.

limits: Predicted MOS is not a human-rating result; calibration for these vocoders has not been performed.
YIN measures relative edit tracking against the same variant and seed native synthesis. Native absolute F0 error is unmeasured; cross-variant support sets and voiced-frame denominators may differ.
Recognition is available for only two of the five recordings. The remaining three have no prepared official excerpt-specific transcript; no ASR output was substituted as ground truth.
Matching CER/WER does not establish waveform, transcript, phoneme-onset or perceptual-quality identity.
An absent threshold violation is not proof of no harm. The original acoustic warnings are preserved.
All observations share five recordings and four speakers. Repeated seeds and executions are not independent samples; the means are descriptive.
Source-periodic AM was not separated. No adoption or formal 120-recording evaluation follows from this addendum.

public_projection.included: All 90 quality scalar records with their missing-value reasons and support counts, all 60 saved paired comparisons, fixed model and source hashes, and descriptive aggregates.
public_projection.array_omission: Each full per-condition metric JSON is identified by SHA-256. The three F0 frame arrays are omitted from the public scalar projection; all their saved scalar summaries and support counts remain.
public_projection.attribution: The LibriSpeech attribution and source modifications are documented in README-ja.md and reproducibility.json.
